Name: Packing
Purpose: The template Packing describes the evolution of a container as an item is added to it.
Context: the template helps describe common situations in the physical world, involving containers such as boxes or palettes.
Design considerations: The ability to describe the state of the container (before and after inserting an item) and the state of the item (before being packed in the container or after).
Details:
This template is a refinement of org.openprovenance.templates.collections.InsertingIntoCollection where the collection is a physical container, and the item is physical.  At the start, there is a container container0 and an item item0. After this operation, the container container1 now contains item item1.
The template is the result of merging four instantiated templates.
- InsertingIntoCollection describes the container and item, before and after the operation
- Triangle3-AGA to capture the agent (packer) responsible for packing the item in the container.
- Triangle2-Entity-SDS to describe that the container before and the container after are both specialisations of a single container.
- Triangle2-Entity-SDS to describe that the item before and the item after are both specialisations of a single item.

As this is a physical operation, the container and item specialisations have a single existence. The creation of item1 and container1 invalidates (in the sense of provenance)  item0 and container0, though we did not make invalidation edges explicit to avoid overcomplicating the visualisation.
